attackers_goals: Adversaries are attempting to infiltrate Okta's administrative application, a breach that could lead to the manipulation of authentication procedures, creation of persistent user accounts, and various activities aiding in the compromise of additional assets.
description: An attempt to access Okta's admin management application.
investigative_actions: Reach out to the user responsible for the alert to confirm the legitimacy of the activity. Examine the user's actions preceding and following the activation of the alert. Assess the reputation of the IP address along with that of the Autonomous System Number (ASN).
name: A user accessed Okta's admin application

variations.description: A user attempted to access the Okta Admin Application in a suspicious way.
